title: Download selected media
summary: Prepare and download the original synthetic media to the test device.
prerequisites: Sign in as the synthetic docs-reviewer.

steps.title: Prepare download
steps.instruction: Search for sunrise, select Synthetic Sunrise.svg, choose Transfer and Prepare download.

steps.title: Download synthetic media
steps.instruction: Choose Download synthetic media. The browser saves the synthetic SVG file.

expected: The downloaded bytes match the source synthetic media hash, recorded in capture-evidence.json.
recovery: If the transfer is Interrupted, restore the test connection and choose Resume before downloading.
